uc_fee.title: UC Admissions - Apply now (application fees & waivers)

uc_fill.title: UC Admissions - Filling out the application

test_policy.notes: UC does not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or scholarships; UCSB does not use them in selection.

requirements.notes: Fee is $80 per campus, $95 for international applicants; fee waivers cover up to four campuses but only for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and AB540-eligible applicants. UC does not require or read letters of recommendation at application. The 4 Personal Insight Questions are the only essays (no campus supplement).

deadlines.label: UC application filing period closes
deadlines.note: Admission decisions released March 1-31, 2027 (some campuses earlier)
deadlines.notes: No early plans. Application opens August 1, 2026 for fall 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if your native language is not English and your education was in a country where English was not the language of instruction, or you have fewer than three years of instruction in English. Complete by the December test date; scores are valid two years and must be available by July.

english.notes: Tests taken January 2026 or later (1-6 scale).

aid.notes: UCSB says financial aid and scholarships for international students are very limited, that aid is primarily for U.S. residents, and that internationals must secure private funding; proof of first-year funding is due to OISS after admission and SIR.

tier_notes.business: No business major (Economics & Accounting is the closest option).
